$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 131 (cut 2 of 117). SCOPE, DECLARED RATHER THAN DISCOVERED: three of the four benefits cut 2 claimed had already arrived incrementally and were verified present before this bar was written -- the transcript is written before it is parsed, records and transcripts stream per prompt, and a single saved transcript can be graded with no host. The one that had NOT arrived is re-grading a whole saved arm, and that is what this bar demands. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE: rewriting the CLI into run/grade/suite verbs. That would break every documented invocation, the calibration flow and the report flow, for no benefit this bar could express. The structural half that DOES matter is done: the grader's input is now always a file on disk, so the suite and a re-grade share one path. If the verb split is wanted it is a separate issue with its own bar, which is the lesson of 133. The re-grade criterion runs against a COPY: --regrade rewrites records in place, and a criterion that mutated a tracked fixture would leave the tree dirty on a passing run -- a defect this repository has shipped before.
